messages:
maria: Quick design ask for next Tue webinar 1: need a compact visual were calling the 'leadflow slab' to show how inbound leads map to content paths (benchmark tile -> demo flow -> sales touch). One hero slide (16:9) + three social crops (square, story, hero). Keep copy snappy.

dan: Do we want a diagram or a process flow?

maria: Hybrid 1 top row: 3 intake sources (paid, organic webinar signups, demo requests) as icons. Center: slab showing routing rules (by score/region/plan). Outputs to: benchmark assets, personalized demo, sales queue. Add KPI callouts for latency & cost benefit (pull from benchmark doc).

dan: Drop the benchmark numbers and brand colors here? Accessibility constraints?

maria: Benchmarks: median latency 90ms (hosted); cost delta ~ -22% per 1k tokens vs naive. Brand: Core Blue (#0A7BFF) + Slate Gray accents. Accessibility: WCAG AA contrast, body >=14px.

ari: For the micro-tiles, two headline variants: (A) 'Faster inference, lower spend' (B) 'Scale inference without surprises'. Which for hero vs socials?

maria: Hero = A. Social tiles = B.

celine: ETA: initial comps by EOD Friday. Do we need an animated export?

maria: Yes 1 one micro-animation for the webinar landing (fade + slight slide). Keep <2MB.

figma-bot: New Figma file created: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/leadflow-slab 1 initial frame + component library.

dan: I'll add a grayscale wireframe and tag you. Two follow-ups: 1) Editable sales layer? 2) Legal pre-check on claims?

maria: 1) Yes, include single edit layer for region/SLA/model variant. 2) Legal looped in 1 @celine please flag if wording needs softening.

celine: Will review today. Confirm we can use 'inference economics' publicly?

maria: Confirmed.

ari: Export specs: hero 1920x1080 PNG + MP4 10s 1080p, square 1080x1080 PNG, story 1080x1920 PNG. Export presets added to Figma.

dan: Uploaded wireframes and micro-tile templates. Ping for tweaks. :eyes:

maria: Perfect. If we get comps earlier we can use them for a quick pre-launch social post.

figma-bot: Comment added on frame 3 by dan: 'Need final KPI numbers from marketing'.

maria: I'll paste final numbers and approve animation spec by Thu morning.

ari: Copy drop: 'Ship inference that just works 1 predictable latency, smarter cost' + CTA: 'See the benchmark' (links to webinar landing).

end of thread
